references.source: UNEP (United Nations Environmental Program). 2017. "Waste Management Outlook for Central Asia."
references.notes: Source was published in 2018 and states "Due to lack of reliable data on the amount in tonnes of the collected municipal solid waste except for Dushanbe and Khujand cities, the conversion from volume to weight applies a factor of 250-300 kg/m3. Considering the reported volume of waste collection at 2 million m3 per year, the amount of this waste is estimated at 0.6 million tonnes. In view of incomplete waste collection coverage and limitations in statistical data, experts estimate that the amount of solid municipal waste generation may be 1 to 2 million tonnes per year."
Value calculated based on total MSW generated per year, divided by 365 and population.

references.source: ADB (Asian Development Bank). 2024. “Tajikistan National Urban Assessment: Making the Case for Accelerated Urbanization.”
references.page: Page xiv, Executive summary, and Page 37, Solid waste management
references.notes: Source states solid waste is not sorted but dumped in 72 landfills/open disposal sites throughout the country. Many of these sites do not comply with international regulations and standards. The number of waste collection points are insufficient and rubbish can be left in yards, streets and open fields for long periods of time.
